docs: none in source; README written from the site's copy and code comments

tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: html/body background and the ground of every plain section (stats, pain, how-it-works, FAQ). Cards sit on it with `border`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: White cards: stat, pain, step, feature, testimonial, plan, FAQ item, modal panel, bot chat bubble, chips, secondary plan button.

tokens.name: surface-warm
tokens.usage: Chat preview card ground (stands in for the WhatsApp wallpaper). Border it with `border-warm`.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: About section ground, under a gold radial wash of `gold-avatar` at 40%.

tokens.name: surface-pill
tokens.usage: Section label pill ground and the FAQ plus disc.

tokens.name: warm-page
tokens.usage: Testimonials section ground, warmed toward gold, with a bottom radial of `warm-glow` at 55%.

tokens.name: warm-glow
tokens.usage: Bottom radial on the testimonials section (55% alpha).

tokens.name: gold-wash
tokens.usage: Feature icon tile ground (emoji sits on it).

tokens.name: gold-wash-strong
tokens.usage: Numbered disc on pain cards; the numeral is `gold` at 12–14px (2.3:1, decorative numbering).

tokens.name: gold-ghost
tokens.usage: Oversized italic step numerals (72–110px) behind step cards. Decorative only: never text that must be read.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body on cards, nav wordmark, prices, FAQ questions. 14.6:1 on `surface`, 14:1 on `page-bg`, 11.7:1 on `wa-user-bubble`.

tokens.name: ink-root
tokens.usage: html/body default color. Sections set `ink` explicitly, so this shows only on unstyled text.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Paragraphs, nav links, plan billing lines, FAQ answers, modal copy, close icon. 7.4:1 on `surface`, 7.1:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: ink-mute
tokens.usage: Captions, price notes, stat labels, feature body copy, footer of chat (10–13.5px). 3.9:1 on `surface` and 3.8:1 on `page-bg`: below 4.5:1 as shipped. Keep it to non-essential captions or raise to `ink-soft`.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Brand gold (skyPalette.gold): CTA gradient top, section-label text, stat numerals, stars, check marks, featured plan 2px border, handles. 2.5:1 on `surface`: fails 4.5:1 for text, so keep it for 24px+ numerals, marks and fills; 11px section labels ship below the floor.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: CTA gradient bottom (180deg `gold` → `gold-deep`), avatar gradient end, Instagram ring. White on it is 3.3:1; the gradient's white label averages ~2.9:1 as shipped.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: skyPalette.goldSoft: reserve tint for the mark and soft gold accents.

tokens.name: gold-hex
tokens.usage: ACCENT constant: SVG mark stroke, hero italic em, chat avatar gradient start, voice play button, Instagram ring. 2.1:1 on `sky-top`: emphasis at 34px+ only.

tokens.name: gold-highlight
tokens.usage: Inset 1px top highlight on gold CTAs at 60% alpha (`shadow-gold`).

tokens.name: gold-avatar
tokens.usage: Testimonial initials avatar gradient start (135deg → `gold-avatar-end`); About section radial wash at 40%.

tokens.name: gold-avatar-end
tokens.usage: Testimonial initials avatar gradient end.

tokens.name: gold-rule
tokens.usage: 36×1px flourish rule above the testimonials heading, at 60% opacity.

tokens.name: gold-pricing-glow
tokens.usage: Pricing section top radial at 55% alpha.

tokens.name: sky-top
tokens.usage: Hero sky gradient 0%. Deepest blue on the site.

tokens.name: sky-mid
tokens.usage: Hero sky gradient 35%; final CTA gradient 0%.

tokens.name: sky-low
tokens.usage: Hero sky gradient 65%.

tokens.name: sky-base
tokens.usage: Hero sky gradient 100%; mobile menu glass top stop (92% alpha).

tokens.name: sky-cta-end
tokens.usage: Final CTA gradient 100%.

tokens.name: sky-bg-top
tokens.usage: skyPalette.bgTop: pricing bottom radial at 50% alpha.

tokens.name: sky-bg-mid
tokens.usage: skyPalette.bgMid: reserve mid-sky tint.

tokens.name: sky-glow
tokens.usage: skyPalette.bgGlow: gold sun glow tint.

tokens.name: sky-wash
tokens.usage: Hero bottom-left radial (90% alpha); final CTA bottom-left radial (80%).

tokens.name: sky-features
tokens.usage: Features section top radial at 50% alpha over `page-bg`.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Sun core center (68px disc, 2px blur, top-right of the hero).

tokens.name: sun-edge
tokens.usage: Sun core gradient 55% stop at 85% alpha.

tokens.name: sun-glow
tokens.usage: Sun halo (360px, 10px blur, 55%→15%→0) and the hero top-right radial at 60%.

tokens.name: sun-ray
tokens.usage: Twelve light rays (SVG polygons, screen blend) 55%→18%→0, rotating 90s.

tokens.name: sun-gold-final
tokens.usage: Final CTA and mobile-menu top-right radial at 55–70% alpha.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Intro overlay ground (mobile brand animation): radial 110% 80% at 50% 40%, 0% stop. Creamy paper, warmer than `page-bg`; also the ground for any piece that reuses the intro.

tokens.name: paper-mid
tokens.usage: Intro paper radial, 60% stop.

tokens.name: paper-edge
tokens.usage: Intro paper radial, 100% stop (edges). A fractal-noise grain (SVG feTurbulence 0.9, 2 octaves) multiplies over it at 35%.

tokens.name: gates-core
tokens.usage: Center of the 'heavenly gates' burst at the end of the intro (420px disc, screen blend, 10px blur) and the ray gradient start. Never as text.

tokens.name: gates-ray
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the 16 intro rays (55%, 35% alpha) and of the burst disc (30%, 90% alpha).

tokens.name: label-trace
tokens.usage: Section label traveling line (SVG stroke gradient 0→85%→0, 11s loop). Decorative, 1.8:1.

tokens.name: menu-hover
tokens.usage: Nav link hover ground (pill).

tokens.name: menu-active
tokens.usage: Nav link pressed ground.

tokens.name: menu-label
tokens.usage: 'NAVEGAR' 9.5px label in the mobile menu. 4.6:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: menu-glass-mid
tokens.usage: Mobile menu glass gradient 55% stop (88% alpha) under 24px blur.

tokens.name: menu-glass-end
tokens.usage: Mobile menu glass gradient 100% stop (85% alpha).

tokens.name: menu-glass-blue
tokens.usage: Mobile menu bottom-left radial at 70%.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default 1px card border: stat, pain, step, feature, testimonial, FAQ, plan (non-featured), chips, Instagram card.

tokens.name: border-soft
tokens.usage: 1px section top/bottom dividers (about, features, pricing).

tokens.name: border-mid

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Phone input 1.5px border; mobile menu button 1px border.

tokens.usage: Ghost CTA 1px border on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: border-gold
tokens.usage: Secondary plan button 1.5px border.

tokens.name: border-warm
tokens.usage: Chat card 1px border on `surface-warm`.

tokens.name: hairline-warm
tokens.usage: Chat header bottom rule.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Testimonial author divider (border-top).

tokens.name: hairline-menu
tokens.usage: Mobile menu header rule at 25% alpha.

tokens.name: hairline-stat
tokens.usage: 1px bottom lip under stat cards (`shadow-card`).

tokens.name: wa-user-bubble
tokens.usage: Outgoing (user) chat bubble ground. Text is `wa-user-ink`.

tokens.name: wa-user-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `wa-user-bubble`. 12.6:1.

tokens.name: online
tokens.usage: 6px online dot in the chat header.

tokens.name: online-text
tokens.usage: 'online · respondendo agora' at 11px on `surface-warm`. 4.3:1: just under 4.5:1 as shipped.

tokens.name: typing-dot
tokens.usage: Typing indicator dots (6px, three, 1100ms bounce).

tokens.name: waveform
tokens.usage: Unplayed voice-message waveform bars (2px wide, 2–20px tall).

tokens.name: waveform-played
tokens.usage: Played waveform bars. 4.8:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: caption-italic
tokens.usage: 'criando música personalizada…' italic 12px caption in the song indicator.

tokens.name: save-bg
tokens.usage: 'Economize 67%' pill ground on plan cards.

tokens.name: save-text
tokens.usage: Text on `save-bg`. 7.1:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Phone input border when invalid.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Input error message, 12.5px. 5.3:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: footer-bg
tokens.usage: Footer ground (sticky under the page).

tokens.name: footer-text
tokens.usage: Footer links and body. 11.9:1 on `footer-bg`.

tokens.name: footer-muted
tokens.usage: Footer tagline. 7:1 on `footer-bg`.

tokens.name: footer-label
tokens.usage: Footer column labels (10–11px uppercase) and copyright line. 3.9:1 on `footer-bg`: below 4.5:1 as shipped.

tokens.name: footer-rule
tokens.usage: Footer 1px dividers.

tokens.usage: Cool navy used inside card and page shadows at 15–18% alpha (rgba(20,30,60,…)).

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: Sua fé, todo dia, e responde.
styles.usage: h1. Desktop clamp(40px, 4.4vw, 60px); mobile 34px. Balanced wrap (text-wrap: balance).

styles.name: hero-em
styles.usage: The italic line inside the hero, in `gold-hex`. One phrase per headline, never a whole heading.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: Três passos simples para começar a caminhar.
styles.usage: Section heading under a SectionLabel. Desktop clamp(32px, 3vw, 44px); mobile 28px. Centered, balanced.

styles.name: h2-final
styles.sample: Sua fé merece um espaço só seu.
styles.usage: Final CTA heading. Desktop clamp(36px, 3.8vw, 52px); mobile 30px. Its italic phrase uses weight 300 in `gold-hex`.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Um espaço só seu, disponível 24h no WhatsApp.
styles.usage: About statement (a paragraph set as display). Desktop clamp(30px, 2.6vw, 40px); mobile 24px. Emphasis phrase italic in `gold-hex`.

styles.name: h3-step
styles.usage: Step card title. Mobile 19px.

styles.name: h3-modal
styles.usage: Modal title. Mobile 22px.

styles.name: h3-card
styles.usage: Feature card title. Mobile 13.5px.

styles.name: faq-q
styles.usage: FAQ question. Mobile 15px.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Plan price figure in `ink`. Mobile 42px. Currency prefix is `price-currency`; ' /mês' is `body` in `ink-mute`.

styles.name: price-currency
styles.usage: Currency prefix, vertical-align top, `ink-soft`. Mobile 16px.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Social-proof counter in `gold`, tabular numerals, counts up over 1.6–2.1s. Mobile 22px.

styles.name: numeral-ghost
styles.usage: Decorative step numeral in `gold-ghost`, top-right of step cards. Mobile 72px.

styles.name: pain-number
styles.usage: Numeral in the 28px pain-card disc, `gold` on `gold-wash-strong`. Mobile 12px in a 22px disc.

styles.name: avatar-initials
styles.usage: Initials in the 40px testimonial avatar, `gold` on the gold-avatar gradient. Mobile 13px in 36px.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: ProfeciaWordmark: the name set in Fraunces 400. Footer 28px desktop / 22px mobile; intro overlay larger.

styles.name: nav-wordmark
styles.usage: Name beside the 32px mark in the header, `ink`. Mobile 18px beside a 28px mark.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Um espaço só seu para fortalecer a fé, com orações, reflexões e músicas.
styles.usage: Hero and final-CTA paragraph in `ink-soft`, max 480px measure. Mobile 15px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Fundamentada na Palavra de Deus, ela ouve, responde e ora com você.
styles.usage: Pain and about card copy; `ink` on pain cards, `ink-soft` on about. Mobile 14px.

styles.name: body-step
styles.sample: Escolha o plano que cabe no seu momento.
styles.usage: Step card body in `ink-soft`. Mobile 13.5px.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Era exatamente da constância que eu precisava.

styles.name: body-p
styles.sample: Pessoas reais que transformaram a relação com a fé.
styles.usage: The P primitive default: intro line under an H2, `ink-soft` (or `ink-mute` when mute). Desktop 16px when passed.

styles.name: body-xs
styles.sample: Peça uma oração e receba uma criada para o que você está vivendo.
styles.usage: Feature card body and plan billing lines. `ink-mute` on features (below 4.5:1), `ink-soft` on plans. Mobile 11.5–12.5px.
